title: EU Public Tenders & Grants Monitor Input

countries.title: Countries (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 or alpha-3)
countries.description: Filter tenders by country codes (e.g. IT, DE, FR).

cpvCodes.title: CPV Codes
cpvCodes.description: Filter tenders by Common Procurement Vocabulary (CPV) codes (e.g. 72000000).

minBudget.title: Minimum Estimated Budget (EUR)
minBudget.description: Minimum estimated contract value in EUR.

maxBudget.title: Maximum Estimated Budget (EUR)
maxBudget.description: Maximum estimated contract value in EUR.

publishedFrom.title: Published From (ISO 8601)
publishedFrom.description: Only include tenders published on or after this ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD).

publishedTo.title: Published To (ISO 8601)
publishedTo.description: Only include tenders published on or before this ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD).

minDeadline.title: Minimum Submission Deadline (ISO 8601)
minDeadline.description: Only include tenders with submission deadline on or after this ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD).

maxDeadline.title: Maximum Submission Deadline (ISO 8601)
maxDeadline.description: Only include tenders with submission deadline on or before this ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD).

maxItems.title: Maximum Items
maxItems.description: Maximum number of normalized tenders to return.
